wrap_mujoco_physics_from_env: wrap a composer Environment into a geometry Physics object using from_env
wrap_mujoco_physics_from_getter: wrap a callable returning mjcf Physics into a geometry Physics object using from_getter
wrap_mujoco_physics_direct: wrap an existing mjcf Physics instance into a geometry Physics object using wrap
get_world_pose_of_frame: get the world pose of a geom, site, camera, or body frame via world_pose
sync_physics_before_step: call sync_before_step on a MujocoPhysics instance to ensure state is synced before stepping
